**Dates:** 26 January; 7, 10 and 14 February; 2 and 7 March.

Each flight carries a small group of at least 5 and no more than 6 passengers. Flights are operated on a Beechcraft King Air 300.

The overnight programme extends the day trip to King George Island. After flying with Antarctic Airways and visiting the sights, the group spends the night at an equipped camp near Collins Glacier. The trip continues the following day, after which the group flies back to Punta Arenas, the capital of the Magallanes region.

On arrival in Punta Arenas, transfer from the airport to the hotel. The price includes 4 nights in a single or double room at Hotel Cabo de Hornos or another hotel of the same category. The booking also includes one set lunch or dinner per person each day.

Apply for the full-day and overnight programme.

On the day before the trip, your guide meets the group at the hotel for a mandatory briefing. There is a welcome cocktail and a detailed overview of the Antarctic programme. The meeting place and time are confirmed the day before the trip. The briefing is a chance to meet the other participants and ask questions about the trip.

You must arrive in Punta Arenas by 17:00 on the day before the trip. Passengers who miss the briefing will not be allowed to fly.
